hypothesis: The thermodynamic instability of 2D crystals is overcome by rolling them into nanotubes, which introduces mechanical stability through curvature-induced strain distribution.
prediction: The radius of carbon nanotubes will be inversely proportional to the square root of the layer thickness of graphite precursors.
measurement_method: Measure the layer thickness of graphite precursors via mechanical cleavage and correlate with the radius of resulting carbon nanotubes using electron microscopy.
falsification_condition: If the radius of carbon nanotubes shows no inverse square root relationship with layer thickness, or if the relationship is positive correlation, the hypothesis is falsified.
